Hello.<br:1/>I am Kim Chang-seong, CEO of Jeongsu E&G.
정수 E&amp;G는 2020년 전남 광양에서 태양광 발전소를 만들기 위: Jeongsu E&G was founded in 2020 in Gwangyang, Jeonnam, to build solar power plants. Our judgment was that, among renewable energy sources, solar delivers the greatest effect for the smallest investment. Our first motto was simple: lease idle factory roofs and put solar panels on them. At the time Jeonnam had many power plants but was furthest behind in using factory roofs, so we started with those empty roofs.
지금 광양과 여수의 산단 지붕은 대부분 채워졌고, 저희 현장은 광양을 넘: Today most industrial-complex roofs in Gwangyang and Yeosu are filled, and our sites have spread beyond Gwangyang across the country. As solar grew in this region, KEPCO transmission line capacity ran short. That is why we also took on ESS, which stores the electricity generated and sends it when the line has room. At the Goheung plant we operate 「4MW」 of solar together with ESS on a single site.
태양광은 설치로 끝나는 사업이 아닙니다. 한 번 올린 설비는 오랫동안 같: Solar is not a business that ends with installation. Once installed, the equipment has to keep running in the same place for a long time.
저희가 사업성 검토와 정부 지원사업 신청부터 발전소 구축, 준공 후 안전: That is also why we handle everything ourselves — feasibility review and government support applications, plant construction, and safety and maintenance after completion.
에너지와 녹색, energy &amp; green. 저희 이름에 담긴 두: Energy and green — energy & green. The two words in our name, we will make real on one roof, one parcel of land at a time.

공장 지붕을 임대하면 초기 투자비가 드나요?: Is there an upfront investment if I lease my factory roof?
설치와 운영 비용은 정수 E&amp;G가 부담하고 건물주는 임대료를 받는: Jeongsu E&G bears installation and operating costs, and the building owner receives rent. If roof waterproofing or reinforcement is needed, the sharing of costs is stated in the contract after the site survey.<span:1>To be confirmed by CEO</span:1>
임대 기간 중 지붕에서 누수가 생기면 어떻게 되나요?: What happens if the roof leaks during the lease period?
설치로 인한 누수는 저희가 책임지고 보수합니다. 기존 노후로 인한 누수는: We repair, at our own responsibility, leaks caused by our installation. For leaks caused by existing deterioration, responsibility is set at the time of contract based on the roof condition inspection.<span:1>To be confirmed by CEO</span:1>
계약 기간 중 공장을 매매하거나 이전하면요?: What if the factory is sold or relocated during the contract period?
임대 계약은 건물에 따라 새 소유주에게 승계하는 것을 원칙으로 하며, 승: As a rule, the lease is transferred to the new owner depending on the building, and the transfer procedure and conditions are set in the contract in advance.<span:1>To be confirmed by CEO</span:1>
임대료는 얼마나, 언제 받나요?: How much rent will I receive, and when?
지붕 면적 · 설치 용량 · 지역 조건에 따라 다릅니다. 실사 후 예상: It depends on roof area, installed capacity and regional conditions. After the site survey we present the expected capacity and rent in writing.<span:1>To be confirmed by CEO</span:1>
상담 신청부터 발전소 준공까지 얼마나 걸리나요?: How long does it take from the consultation request to plant completion?
현장 실사 → 사업성 검토 → 인허가(발전사업 허가 · 개발행위 · 한전: The work proceeds in the order of site survey → feasibility review → permitting (power-generation business license · development permit · KEPCO grid connection) → construction → completion, and takes 「0–00」 months in total depending on permitting and grid-connection waiting periods.<span:1>To be confirmed by CEO</span:1>
한전 선로 용량이 부족하다는데 발전소를 지을 수 있나요?: I hear KEPCO line capacity is short. Can a plant still be built?
전남 동부권은 송전선로 여유가 적은 지역이 많습니다. 계통 연계 가능 여: Many areas in eastern Jeonnam have little spare transmission capacity. We first check whether grid connection is possible and, if necessary, propose a configuration that links ESS to store power and send it later.<span:1>To be confirmed by CEO</span:1>
정부 지원사업은 어떤 것이 있고 신청을 대신해 주나요?: What government support programs are there, and will you apply on my behalf?
설치 보조 · 융자 · 공공기관 대상 사업 등이 있으며, 대상 여부 확인: There are installation subsidies, loans and programs for public institutions, and we handle everything from checking eligibility to preparing and submitting application documents.<span:1>To be confirmed by CEO</span:1>
설치 후 발전량은 어떻게 확인하나요?: How do I check generation after installation?
인버터와 연동된 모니터링 시스템으로 웹 · 모바일에서 실시간 발전량을 확: With the monitoring system linked to the inverter, you can check real-time generation on web and mobile, and we send alerts for low generation or faults.<span:1>To be confirmed by CEO</span:1>
정기 점검은 얼마나 자주 하나요?: How often are periodic inspections done?
